statCard.name: The Wrecking Crew
statCard.alterEgo: Brian Calusky, Dirk Garthwaite, Eliot Franklin, Henry Camp

attacks.name: Indestructi-Ball
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!hit| |*Thunderous Impact|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Piledriver
steps: After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt and the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Away |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |*Suplex|: After the attack is resolved, if the defender has the |§stun§Stun| special condition, it gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

attacks.name: Wrecking Bar Fling
steps: After the Range Tool is placed for this attack, destroy all |!size| 2 or smaller interactive terrain features it overlaps. Add 1 die to each attack roll made as part of this attack for each terrain feature destroyed in this way.
After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After each attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt and the defender has the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition, Throw it Away |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Bulldoze
superPowers.body: Push this character |!movement_medium|. It does not stop its movement if it contacts a |!size| 2 or smaller interactive terrain feature. Instead, the contacted terrain feature is destroyed, then this character continues being Pushed. If this character contacts 1 or more other enemy characters, choose 1 contacted character. The chosen character suffers 1 |!damage|, then this character stops as normal. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Let‘s Take‘em Down Boys!
superPowers.body: After an attack made by this character during its Activation is resolved, it may use this superpower. This character makes an attack action and must choose an attack it has not used yet this Activation. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Enchanted by Karnilla
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
